specs.Item Type Name: Free Dish Set Top Box with Wi-Fi

features: Compatible with Smart TVs, LED, LCD, and CRT TVs, thanks to both HDMI and AV (RCA) output options.
Receives free-to-air channels via the DD Free Dish platform – one-time cost, lifetime free viewing.
MPEG-4 HD Picture Quality. Supports MPEG-4 compression and High Definition (HD) resolution for sharper, clearer visuals on HD-ready and Full HD TVs.
Easy Plug-and-Play Setup :- Simple installation with user-friendly interface – just connect your dish antenna and start watching. USB Multimedia Support.
Important: Do not update the set-top box software, as doing so may cause the remote control to stop functioning properly.
description: Built-in USB port allows you to play videos, music, and view photos from a USB drive. Multiple Language Support. On-screen menu available in English, Hindi, and sometimes other regional languages for ease of use.
